admitted_claims: The two M51-r1 P1 runner defects are closed at source/static/pure-CPU/mock-CUDA control-flow level for the exact pinned r2 sources.

A successful mocked candidate main() executes exactly 12 CUDA fences: one pre-capture, ten post-forward/per-sample, and one distinct final pre-manifest fence; memory snapshots are ordered after reset and after the final fence.

The unchanged frozen r1 trace independently reconstructs 31 modules (7 Conv2d and 24 Linear), 310 hook calls, 3100 dual-line rows, 10506240000 input bits, and 1313280000 packed bytes with zero plan mismatches.
claim_boundary: GO means the pinned r2 runner is admitted for the real ten-sample H67 ep35 GPU capture. It does not admit a checkpoint-opened run, real CUDA memory values, activation payload, cycles, speedup, PPA, power, energy, DATE completeness, or best-paper claims.

findings.evidence: Both producer and independent reruns remain CPU/static/mock only; the launch manifest states GPU_NOT_EXECUTED and the checkpoint is absent on this host.
findings.required_action: Run the exact pinned command on the checkpoint host, then verify checkpoint/config/source hashes, 310 payload files, manifest population, payload hashes, and recorded CUDA memory values.
findings.title: Real CUDA/checkpoint/payload execution is still pending

findings.evidence: The inherited close publishes manifest.json by hard-link before unlinking its temporary. An error after publication but before closed=True can make the command fail while a complete PASS manifest exists; abort then intentionally refuses FAILED beside PASS.
findings.required_action: For operational hardening, make post-publication cleanup non-fatal or set/persist a committed state immediately after the atomic link and treat the published manifest as authoritative.
findings.title: Post-publication close cleanup can report command failure after a valid PASS

findings.evidence: Forward-hook handles are removed in finally after writer.close(); a handle.remove() BaseException can therefore fail the process after PASS publication.
findings.required_action: Make hook teardown best-effort after a committed PASS, or complete teardown before close while preserving the final CUDA fence.
findings.title: Hook teardown remains outside the PASS/FAILED state machine

findings.evidence: The memory fields prove that CUDA allocator telemetry was sampled, but only a real run can quantify peak capture memory and empirically confirm that all 31 actual hook tensors satisfy default C contiguity.
findings.required_action: On the GPU host, report before/after allocated/reserved peaks, fail closed on any real non-contiguous hook, and retain the manifest as the evidence boundary.
findings.title: Memory/layout evidence has not yet been observed on real tensors

not_admitted: No real GPU capture, checkpoint-opened execution, activation payload, or measured CUDA-memory value is admitted.
No cycle, speedup, throughput, PPA, power, or energy result is admitted.
No DATE paper-completeness or best-paper conclusion follows from this runner review.

M51-P1-01.evidence: Candidate lines 310-325 order model -> per-sample synchronize -> end_sample and distinct final synchronize -> memory -> close; lines 329-334 catch BaseException and abort. Independent candidate-main mock observes success counts 1+10+1 and FAILED-only/no-manifest/zero-partial outcomes for post-forward sync, final sync, and prepublication close faults.

M51-P1-02.evidence: Candidate stream lines 76-84 gates default is_contiguous before detach().view(-1), contains no activation contiguous()/reshape copy, and chunks only after the gate. Independent mock proves rejection before detach/view/copy and metadata-only view on a contiguous empty tensor; writer close requires all eight before/after memory values.
